But with the right preparation, you can turn this challenge into an opportunity to boost resident satisfaction and prove your property is ahead of the curve\.
If you’re asking yourself “What is the best package management solution for my community?”, you’re in the right place\. Below, we’ve outlined the most common questions property managers face, along with insights from our Multifamily Guide to Package Management\.
- [The Ultimate Guide to Automated Package Rooms](https://www.luxerone.com/the-ultimate-guide-to-automated-package-rooms/): Managing packages has quickly become one of the top challenges for multifamily communities\. With residents shopping online more than ever, staff are overwhelmed, lobbies are cluttered, and resident satisfaction is on the line\. A automated package room can be the solution, but how do you know if it’s the right fit for your property?

This guide to automated package rooms answers the most common questions property managers ask, helping you evaluate whether a package room is the right investment for your community\.
- [How Do I Find the Best Package Management Solution for My Community?](https://www.luxerone.com/the-best-package-management-solution/): Package delivery is no longer a side task for onsite teams, it's a daily operational challenge\. With residents receiving more than ten packages a month on average and package volume growing 67% since 2019, property staff are now spending up to 10 hours a week managing deliveries\. Add in the rising issue of package theft, and it’s no surprise that package management for multifamily has become a top priority\.
If you’re asking yourself “What is the best package management solution for my community?”, you’re in the right place\. Below, we’ve outlined the most common questions property managers face, along with insights from our Multifamily Guide to Package Management\.

But new opportunities are opening for organizations ready to modernize their approach\.
From federal grants to local partnerships, government funding for food pantries has expanded in recent years to support infrastructure upgrades, technology innovation, and programs that improve equitable access to food\. For many communities, that means new potential to integrate solutions like smart lockers that make food distribution safer, faster, and more accessible\.
